items.title: Is Cyberpunk 2 really cancelled? The truth behind the developer’s viral GTA 6 breakdown
items.summary: Has Cyberpunk 2 really been cancelled? The internet went into a collective frenzy when news broke that the highly anticipated sequel to Cyberpunk 2077 was seemi
items.content:
Copied Has Cyberpunk 2 really been cancelled? The internet went into a collective frenzy when news broke that the highly anticipated sequel to Cyberpunk 2077 was seemingly scrapped. However, fans of the dystopian franchise can breathe a massive sigh of relief. The startling announcement was nothing more than a self-deprecating joke made by CD Projekt Red creative director Igor Sarzyński in response to the staggering success of Grand Theft Auto VI .

Rockstar Games recently launched GTA 6 to record-breaking acclaim and generated an estimated $3.79 billion in worldwide retail sales within its first 24 hours. This monumental launch left developers across the gaming industry in absolute awe. Taking to the social media platform Bluesky, Igor expressed his deep amazement at the sheer scale of the competitor's game.

"GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression is real," he wrote online. "Probably the single greatest artistic achievement in history, I mean it. Scale, density, coherence, thoughtfulness of it all, just a technological and creative miracle." He playfully concluded the viral post by adding, "Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled, imma go sweep autumn leaves in my backyard now."

He is certainly not alone in his professional astonishment. Michael Barclay, a world design director at Naughty Dog, mirrored this industry-wide sentiment. Michael stated that the new title appeared to him "as a Bugatti Veyron would to a nervous Victorian child."

Despite the humorous hyperbole, the Cyberpunk sequel remains firmly in active development. Currently codenamed Project Orion, the title officially entered pre-production in May 2025 and is being built on Unreal Engine 5 by North American development teams.

Quick to reassure panicked fans, Igor clarified that his team is not trying to directly replicate the Rockstar formula but is instead carving its own distinct path.

"Seriously though, I think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavour," he explained. "GTA is impressive in a way all great art is: It expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed."

items.content:
This article needs JavaScript to display. Please turn on JavaScript in your browser and reload the page. CD Projekt joint CEO Michał Nowakowski has congratulated Rockstar on Grand Theft Auto VI , calling it a masterpiece while saying he plans to spend the coming weeks and months exploring it.

His November 19 message praised the people who made the game and acknowledged how difficult an achievement like that can be. It is a warm launch-day response from the company behind Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher .

Nowakowski's comment is a congratulatory message, not a detailed review. He did not say he had completed the game; in fact, he wrote that he intended to explore it over a longer period.

Vice City is part of GTA VI’s fictional state of Leonida. Image: Rockstar Games

The CD Projekt executive shared a launch-day greeting from the official Cyberpunk 2077 account. That message played on the names of the two games' cities and congratulated Rockstar.

Lucia and Jason are GTA VI’s two protagonists. Image: Rockstar Games

Other CD Projekt developers joined in. Paweł Sasko , associate game director on the next Cyberpunk , praised an early look at the game, while The Witcher 4 director Sebastian Kalemba said he was looking forward to spending a weekend with it.

It is easy to see why people connect the games: both Cyberpunk 2077 and GTA VI ask players to spend time in a detailed fictional setting. They are still different games, with different stories and design goals, so a launch-day compliment is best read as appreciation between developers rather than a judgment about which one is better.

GTA VI launched on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19. Image: Rockstar Games

GTA VI launched on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19. The following day, Take-Two estimated $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales. That figure is the publisher's sales estimate, not a count of players.

Rockstar's story follows Jason and Lucia in Leonida, a fictional state that includes Vice City. The publisher describes them as a couple drawn into a conspiracy after a job goes wrong. Nowakowski did not single out a particular mission or character in his message.

For anyone considering the boxed PS5 edition , there is a practical detail to check: it contains a download code, not a disc. Amazon's listing specifies a US or Canadian PlayStation account for redemption and marked the item non-returnable when checked.

Who says Black Friday is dead? Walmart has just pulled out some of the best deals of the Black Friday sales , the year, and even the past few years, to that end.

The major US retailer has cut prices across the board for brand-new video games, dropping even some of the biggest games of the past couple of years to all-time lows.

For $30 each, even just for Switch 2, you can bag Donkey Kong Bananza , Kirby Air Riders, Super Mario Party Jamboree, and Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2.

Beyond that, you can also grab Resident Evil Requiem, Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, The Blood of Dawnwalker, and Saros all for just $30 on PS5. Those are proper Black Friday offerings, all days before the official "Nov. 27 sale" begins. I'd pick these up ASAP, as every single one will likely sell out in due course.

The sale is bafflingly good; there's even a whole bunch of $15 games here that I haven't listed out as well, that are also worth checking out if you click through to the full sale . That includes Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds, Sonic Frontiers, Elden Ring, Star Wars Outlaws, Mortal Kombat 1, GTA V, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, Red Dead Redemption 2, Assassin's Creed Shadows, and loads more.

I'm especially surprised by the Switch 2 deals, since Nintendo officially knocked $20 off each of these games in the sale, but Walmart has gone one step further with an additional $20 discount. That's over 50% off for Donkey Kong Bananza, and probably the best discount you'll see on the game for a long, long time. It makes this feel more like a price error, than a genuine deal. And yet, there it is!

If you're feeling bold, you should also try the codes SAVE3X / FAST30 / TRIPLE10 / DOUBLE10 to see if you can get an extra $10 taken off your total as well. Let us know if you have any success with this in the comments as well, as $20 for any of these games is basically daylight robbery.

It's so surprising to see such great offers, it feels surreal. As you well know, Black Friday can tend to be filled with mediocre discounts that offer shoppers barely a flicker of a decent discount. Long gone are the days where we'd see true doorbuster deals. Well, welcome back doorbusters, as these game discounts are actually worth the hype.

I'd also expect to see the likes of Amazon price matching at least some of these soon as well, just in case Walmart does sell out, so I'll include links there as well where I can.

Also, just to note, you're better off looking at the digital versions for the Switch 2 games, as the physical copies in the sale are likely already all bought up. Several even have a status similar to Amazon's "lighting deals", where there's a percentage available this price point. Kirby Air Riders for Switch 2 (physical edition), for example, is at 55% claimed when I'm writing this. So when it's gone, it's gone.

Additionally, most will require you to add the game to your cart in order to see the discount. And, finally, if any of the physical editions do show up as out of stock, it's worth checking within the Walmart app, as there seems to be a seperate allocation dedicated for app users.

items.title: Godfather Of Cyberpunk Also Hooked On Watching GTA 6 Clips
items.summary: Arcade addicts of the 1980s inspired the cyberspace of William Gibson’s influential Neuromancer, now the author is transfixed on viral footage of Rockstar’s ultra-hit
items.content:
Cyberpunk Grand Theft Auto 6 Neuromancer William Gibson

William Gibson, the science fiction author often credited for establishing the cyberpunk genre, took plenty of inspiration from video game culture in the ’70s and ’80s. Despite this, and the influence of works like Neuromancer has had on the medium, Gibson says he doesn’t partake in the hobby, claiming this weekend that he’s never even played a video game. One game seems to be recapturing his interest, though, the forefather of virtual reality allured by viral Grand Theft Auto clips online.

“I’ve never played a video game in my life, but this thing [ Grand Theft Auto ] actually does [seem] interesting,” posted Gibson . “When I said that I found that clip of the new GTA interesting, I didn’t mean that it made me interested in learning to play it, but interested in what it was that I found intriguing, in some mysterious way, in its…texture?…depth? I don’t know.”

When I said that I found that clip of the new GTA interesting, I didn’t mean that it made me interested in learning to play it, but interested in what it was that I found intriguing, in some mysterious way, in its…texture?…depth? I don’t know.

— William Gibson (@greatdismal.bsky.social) 2026-11-22T03:23:17.866Z

In the early ‘80s, William Gibson released Neuromancer , the first novel in his ‘Sprawl’ series and an establishing work of cyberpunk literature. In it, hackers, mercenaries and ‘street samurai’ orchestrate a heist across cities, planets and virtual realities. Much of the nomenclature around the digital world and the notion of cyberspace come from his works . And much of that world was built through observing teens and drug peddlers looming around Vancouver arcades in the ‘70s, as well as the rapid transformation of computers from fridge-sized number crunchers to desktop work stations .

Despite changing video games forever, and games directly adapted from his works, Gibson hasn’t participated in playing them. Replying to fans stunned he’s never given one a whirl, Gibson says it’s possible he tried Pong , “on a tabletop in a bar?”

Now, like thousands others, Gibson is hooked on amusing clips emerging out of Grand Theft Auto VI . The one kicking off the conversation featuring a boom barrier launching Jason like a catapult to Lucia’s embarrassment. This time from the comfort of homes and phones, people around the world are sitting backseat to endless streams of the new game. Even those who don’t consider themselves players taken in by virtual birdwatchers and infrastructure fanatics .

“I was enthralled by this one streamer pretending to host a nature documentary while wandering around the wilderness of Leonida,” writes Defector ’s Brandy Jensen on being unexpectedly taken in by GTA streams. “I cheered as Jason is, for reasons that remain completely beyond me, rescued by a dog driving a jetski. I even found myself beguiled by the many ways a digitally rendered human body can react to getting hit by a basketball.”

If the early sales figures are true , Grand Theft Auto VI is the highest performing piece of media of all time. The ramifications of which are surreal to wrap your head around, regardless of being an eager fan or a cultural observer. It has even reeled in William Gibson, though he’s still figuring out the words to describe the phenomenon. And once he does, maybe it’ll lay the groundwork for the next century of speculative dystopia.

items.title: I played Cyberpunk 2077 for free in my browser with a budget laptop
items.summary: Cyberpunk 2077 in your browser for FREE? We put it to the test, and the results might surprise you. 🎮
items.content:
Cyberpunk 2077 is playable for free in your browser, and we've put it to the test.

Cyberpunk 2077 fans can now play CD Projekt RED's popular RPG in Google Chrome for free, without cloud gaming.

Not long ago, we never imagined huge games like CD Projekt RED's Cyberpunk 2077 could be played for free in a browser. But as we've seen with the 128-player browser version of Halo: Combat Evolved, things that once seemed impossible are now a reality.

Of course, this is an unofficial project created by omonkeyzz and isn't affiliated with CD Projekt RED . How long it will remain online is unclear, especially as similar browser projects have disappeared after gaining attention.

Unlike cloud gaming services such as GeForce NOW, this version runs on your own PC rather than streaming from a remote server. The game loads through your browser, so there's no need for a traditional installation, although you'll still need a capable PC to play it.

The browser version of Cyberpunk 2077 uses WebAssembly (Wasm) to run compiled code directly in your browser, while WebGPU allows it to use your PC's graphics hardware to render the game's 3D world. This means the game runs on your own hardware rather than being streamed from a remote server, although the browser still needs to load game data to get everything running.

The browser version also doesn't include the Phantom Liberty expansion, although that could potentially change in the future. Of course, there's no guarantee how long the project will remain available online. As it's still relatively new, you're also likely to encounter some bugs, and even a high-end PC might not run it as smoothly as the official version.

It's worth noting that, as impressive as this browser version of Cyberpunk 2077 is, it does have its limitations, which will largely depend on your PC's capabilities. Even though it runs in a browser, your hardware still has to handle the game's graphics and processing demands. I tried playing it on my budget laptop and, let's just say, it struggled. However, I can confirm that it works and includes features such as choosing your Lifepath and full character customisation.

After you've finished creating your character, you can begin playing and exploring Night City, much as you would in the official release.

Loading the game can also take a while, unlike the browser version of Halo: Combat Evolved , which loads almost instantly. Cyberpunk 2077 is a much more demanding game, and the browser needs time to load the relevant game data and compile shaders before you can get started.

READ MORE: 13 best Cyberpunk 2077 mods that feel essential for PC players

While the browser version of Cyberpunk 2077 is primarily designed for PC, it has reportedly worked on some modern Android phones. However, compatibility and performance can vary depending on your device, and support for iPhone, iPad and tablets isn't fully confirmed. That being said, it's not something we'd recommend trying right now.

Yes, I'd say so. Even if it struggles to run on your system, it's worth trying out of pure curiosity. It's impressive to see what's possible with modern web browsers.

However, we'd still recommend playing the official release of Cyberpunk 2077 , whether you're on PC, PlayStation, Xbox or Nintendo Switch 2. The official release offers the full game experience, and depending on the platform and edition, you can also access post-launch content and updates. The Phantom Liberty expansion is sold separately or included in certain editions and bundles.

items.title: From the Anime to the Game — Free Update Brings Edgerunners 2 Content and More to Cyberpunk 2077!
items.summary: The free Edgerunners 2 Update to Cyberpunk 2077 is available now, with content inspired by the second installment of the hit anime series now streaming on Netflix
items.content:
“Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2” premiered on Netflix on October 20, bringing a whole new cast of characters to Night City for a dark, gritty ride. And now we’re bringing a little piece of that story into Cyberpunk 2077 , too! The free Edgerunners 2 Update is here, with content inspired by the anime, new ways to fight, more customization options, and plenty of other additions.

We’ve got a lot to cover, so let’s get into it. And don’t worry if you haven’t watched the new anime yet — no “Edgerunners 2” spoilers ahead!

One of the things we love about Night City is that there’s always another story unfolding somewhere. V may be central to the events of Cyberpunk 2077 , but they’re hardly the only merc in town, fighting to survive and make a name for themselves on those neon-soaked streets. Every fixer has clients, every crew has gigs to take care of, every Night City merc has their story — and sometimes, those stories collide in unexpected ways.

That’s exactly what happens in the brand-new quest introduced with the “Edgerunners 2” Update. What begins as just another gig from Wakako turns into an action-packed, high-stakes mission that sees V cross paths with Weak Kingsley, a famed Night City merc and one of the main characters of “Edgerunners 2.” We won’t spoil what happens, but during the course of this mission, V has a chance to assist Weak and his crew during a risky gig that takes place in a brand-new location: Night City Prison.

The new “Edgerunners 2” gig is more than a chance to encounter characters from the anime in the game — it serves as a prequel to the events of the series. So, play the quest before watching the anime, and you’ll have a little extra context going into Episode 1. Already seen the show? Then with this gig, you’ll get to revisit part of Weak’s story with a broader perspective of him and his crew.

And there’s even more forEdgerunnersfans in this update. For starters, you can find and equip Weak’s full outfit — vest, glasses, coat, pants, the works — and get your hands on his signature revolver, Coronation. We’ve also added a new radio station, HKGN 102.FM, featuring official tracks from both “Cyberpunk: Edgerunners” and “Edgerunners 2.” So if you’re planning to spend a few more hours cruising around Night City after watching the show, we’ve got your soundtrack covered.

What’s better than blasting your way through a warehouse full of gangoons with a revolver, dealing one headshot after another? Doing it with two revolvers, obviously.

That’s right — dual wielding is here! With the Edgerunners 2 Update, you can raise hell with a pistol or revolver in each hand. That’s a whole new vibe — and a whole new level of awesome.

But dual wielding isn’t just about looking cool. It brings a new playstyle and a fresh way to approach combat — in fact, it’s one of the most significant gameplay additions to the game’s combat since Update 2.0 introduced throwing knives. So if you’ve been looking for an excuse to shake up your fighting style, this might just be it.

Cyberware enhances your stats and abilities — but what if it could take your style to the next level, too? That’s where glamdocs come in. These new vendors let you customize the appearance of your cyberware, with 40 styles in different colors to choose from. Fancy a new look for your chrome? Pay them a visit at one (or all) of the five locations across Night City and see what catches your eye.

In a city that lives and dies by appearances, V really can’t afford to pass up any opportunity to shake up their look. On top of cyberware customization, we’ve also added 20 new hairstyles and several clothing sets to give your V the best chance of standing out, even in Night City.

We know how creative the Cyberpunk 2077 community can be, and we’re always curious to see what players come up with. That’s why we’re introducing cross-platform mod support through mod.io integration.

The update adds a Mods panel where you can browse and install supported community-created content directly in the game. It’s a new way to experiment with your experience, and we’re looking forward to seeing how it develops as more mods become available and receive support over time!

We’ve covered some of the bigger additions, but there’s still plenty to find in the Edgerunners 2 Update.

  • Sometimes one gun just isn't enough. The new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree (along with four auxiliary perks) introduces an entirely new playstyle, allowing you to dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category.

    [/*]

  • Added frames from the Cyberpunk Trading Card Game to Photo Mode, allowing you to make your preem shots look like custom cards.

    [/*]

  • Added new poses in Photo Mode to show off your dual-wielding prowess.

    [/*]

Mod the World

Added Cross-Platform Mod Support, powered by mod.io, a first step into cross-platform modding that allows you to easily browse and install a selection of player-created mods directly from the in-game menu. More mods will become available over time. The feature is available on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S.

Upgrading the World

  • Welcome to Paradise! Added a new side quest that takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night. It unlocks after completing The Heist and reaching level 15 Street Cred.

    [/*]

  • Added 12 new Minor Arcana Tarot Cards to discover across Night City. The Tarot menu now has separate sections for Major and Minor Arcana. The new tarot cards are part of a new side quest, an extension of Fool on the Hill, which activates after scanning any of the new cards. Collect them all to get a special reward.

    [/*]

Quality of Life

  • Saves in the “Load Game” menu are now grouped by separate playthroughs.

    [/*]

  • Added item filters to apartment and vehicle stashes.

    [/*]

  • Modded saves in the "Load Game" menu are now marked with a dedicated icon. Please note that achievements and trophies cannot be earned while playing on console from a modded save file.

    [/*]

  • Updated the selection of AMD FSR options. FSR 3 upscaling is no longer included, while FSR 2.1, FSR 4, and FSR 3.1 Frame Generation remain available.

    [/*]

  • Updated the CD PROJEKT RED Account connection, My Rewards and telemetry consent menus.

    [/*]

Technology

  • Added support for DLSS 4.5, including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation or Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the 2nd Generation Transformer Model.

    [/*]

  • Added support for glasses-free 3D effects on compatible Samsung Odyssey 3D monitors, along with a Motion Comfort setting that lets you balance 3D depth and viewing comfort.

    [/*]

  • Added support for MetalFX Frame Interpolation on Mac.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle in settings for FSR Anti-Lag 2.

    [/*]

  • Introduced various performance optimizations, including improvements specifically for Ray Tracing.

    [/*]

  • Improved HDR rendering to provide more accurate colors, brightness, and contrast on compatible displays.

    [/*]

Fixes

  • Things Done Changed- Fixed an issue where the Delamain cab could get stuck after crashing into another vehicle, blocking quest progression.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where enabling Film Grain had no effect.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where tagging enemies while scanning could also cause V to crouch or stand up when using certain control schemes.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where controller settings for the Third-Person Camera were missing.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several typos in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added various other fixes for features and content introduced since Patch 2.1.

    [/*]

items.content:
To survive in Night City, you need someone to watch your back. On the way to the major leagues, V managed to gather a remarkable crew. You could even say, a crew to remember!

From trusted allies to unforgettable personalities, these are the people who helped shape V’s journey through the City of Dreams. This episode of It’s All About You is dedicated to the legendary crew that stood by V through every high and low.

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk 2077 in the most creative ways possible. Don’t forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY

See you in the next episode!

items.title: It’s All About You! — Never Fade Away

items.content:
Listen up, Samurai! 🤘🔥

Celebrate five years of Cyberpunk 2077 in this special anniversary episode of It’s All About You, looking back on Night City’s unforgettable stories through the legends and music you met along your journey!

Sure, the city’s full of noise — sirens, synths, gunfire in the distance — but if there’s one song that became its soul, it’s “Never Fade Away.”

We brought together legendary artists from across the city of dreams to reinterpret this iconic track — each in their own voice, their own style, their own rebellion. ❤️‍🔥

Plug in, turn it up, and dive into our latest It’s All About You episode.

Because legends don’t fade.
